slides.sub: Five checks, from Sainte-Dorothée to Saint-François.

photo.credit: Entering Saint-François, Laval · Photo: Fabioski01, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Know what's at stake

photo.credit: REM Sainte-Dorothée, Laval · Photo: One of Many Tims, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia

slides.body: Median house price: **$747,812** in Sainte-Dorothée, **$541,437** in Saint-François. Worth a careful look first.

slides.title: Ask for the RBQ certificate
slides.body: Québec's building authority now certifies pre-purchase inspectors. Ask for the certificate before you book.

slides.title: Look them up in the registry
slides.body: Search the name in the RBQ's free online registry. Every inspector with a valid certificate is listed.

slides.title: Ask which standard they follow
slides.body: **BNQ 3009-500** sets uniform practices for pre-purchase inspections in Québec. Ask if your inspector follows it.

slides.title: Mind the inspection deadline
slides.body: In OACIQ's example: **10 days** to inspect, then **4 days** to notify the seller in writing, report attached.
